backlog.title: Scaffold repo directory structure
backlog.description: Create the full skeleton — src/relay/{api,domain,services,repositories,workers,infra,web}, migrations/, tests/{unit,integration,e2e,load}, docs/adr/, docker/, .github/workflows/ — with __init__.py placeholders so the layout is fixed before any code lands.

backlog.title: Init uv project, pin Python 3.12, lockfile
backlog.description: pyproject.toml with Python 3.12 pin and core deps (fastapi, uvicorn, sqlalchemy, alembic, redis) declared; `uv lock` produces a committed lockfile so builds are reproducible.

backlog.title: Configure ruff lint + format baseline
backlog.description: ruff config in pyproject.toml (lint + format rules chosen); `uv run ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` both pass clean on the empty skeleton.

backlog.title: Configure mypy strict baseline
backlog.description: mypy config targeting src/relay with strict-ish settings enabled; `uv run mypy src` passes clean on the skeleton with zero suppressions.

backlog.title: Set up pre-commit hooks for ruff/mypy
backlog.description: .pre-commit-config.yaml wires ruff, ruff-format, and mypy as local hooks; `pre-commit run --all-files` passes and hooks are documented as required in README.

backlog.title: Add .gitignore and .dockerignore
backlog.description: .gitignore covers Python/uv/venv/IDE artifacts; .dockerignore excludes tests, .git, docs, and dev tooling from the build context so image builds stay small and fast.

backlog.title: Bootstrap FastAPI app entrypoint
backlog.description: src/relay/api exposes an ASGI app factory (create_app), runnable via uvicorn locally with an empty router — no business endpoints yet, just a booting app.

backlog.title: Add pydantic-settings config module
backlog.description: src/relay/infra config module loads all runtime settings (DB URL, Redis URL, ports, log level) from env vars via pydantic-settings, with a typed Settings object injected into the app.

backlog.title: Write .env.example with all variables documented
backlog.description: Every env var consumed by Settings is listed with a comment explaining purpose and a safe example value; no real secrets present; referenced from README.

backlog.title: Configure pytest + FastAPI TestClient fixtures
backlog.description: pytest config plus conftest.py providing an app/TestClient fixture, so tests/unit and tests/integration can both import and exercise the app.

backlog.title: Implement /healthz liveness endpoint
backlog.description: GET /healthz returns 200 with no dependency checks (process-alive only); unit test asserts 200 and expected payload shape.

backlog.title: Add SQLAlchemy async engine/session setup
backlog.description: src/relay/infra defines an async engine/session factory built from Settings' DB URL, with a FastAPI dependency for a request-scoped session — no models yet.

backlog.title: Wire Alembic migrations (env.py, initial revision)
backlog.description: alembic init under migrations/, env.py reads DB URL from Settings (not hardcoded), and an initial empty revision runs `alembic upgrade head` successfully against local Postgres.

backlog.title: Provision test DB via Alembic, not create_all
backlog.description: Integration test fixture spins up/points at a test database and applies schema exclusively via `alembic upgrade head`; confirm zero calls to Base.metadata.create_all anywhere in the repo.

backlog.title: Add Redis client wiring in infra layer
backlog.description: src/relay/infra defines a Redis client/connection factory built from Settings' Redis URL, exposed as a FastAPI dependency — no stream logic yet, just connectivity.

backlog.title: Implement /readyz checking Postgres + Redis
backlog.description: GET /readyz performs a real query against Postgres and a real ping against Redis, returning 200 only if both succeed and 503 with a per-dependency breakdown otherwise; tests cover both healthy and simulated-failure cases.

backlog.title: Write multi-stage Dockerfile (builder + runtime)
backlog.description: Builder stage installs deps via uv into a venv/wheel; runtime stage is slim, copies only the built artifact, and dependency layers are ordered so code changes don't invalidate the dep cache.

backlog.title: Harden Dockerfile: non-root, read-only, pinned digest
backlog.description: Runtime stage runs as a non-root user, sets a read-only root filesystem (with explicit writable tmpfs where needed), pins the base image by digest, and adds a HEALTHCHECK hitting /healthz.

backlog.title: Build image locally, record size in README
backlog.description: `docker build` succeeds, final image size is captured and added to README alongside the build command, giving a baseline to track regressions against.

backlog.title: Write docker-compose.yml (api, postgres, redis)
backlog.description: Compose file brings up api + postgres + redis with named volumes for Postgres data, env vars sourced from .env, and api depends_on healthy postgres/redis.

backlog.title: Add Caddy service to compose for local proxying
backlog.description: Caddy service added to compose with a local Caddyfile reverse-proxying to the api container over plain HTTP for local dev (no TLS requirement yet).

backlog.title: Verify local stack boots, /readyz goes green
backlog.description: `docker compose up` brings the full stack up from a clean state and curl against /readyz through Caddy returns 200, confirming api, Postgres, and Redis are correctly wired end to end.

backlog.title: Write Makefile for common dev commands
backlog.description: Makefile exposes targets for lint, typecheck, test, up/down, migrate, and build so all dev workflows are one command; referenced from README as the canonical entrypoint.

backlog.title: CI job: ruff + mypy on every PR
backlog.description: GitHub Actions workflow triggered on PR runs ruff check, ruff format --check, and mypy src, failing the check on any violation.

backlog.title: CI job: pytest unit + integration suite
backlog.description: CI job spins up Postgres/Redis service containers and runs pytest tests/unit tests/integration, failing the PR check on any test failure.

backlog.title: CI job: Alembic upgrade/downgrade round-trip
backlog.description: CI job runs alembic upgrade head, downgrade -1, upgrade head against a scratch Postgres service container on every PR, catching irreversible or broken migrations before merge.

backlog.title: CI job: import-linter architecture contracts
backlog.description: import-linter config encodes the intended layering (api → services → domain/repositories → infra, no reverse imports) and runs as a required CI job.

backlog.title: CI job: pip-audit dependency scan
backlog.description: pip-audit runs against the locked dependency set on every PR and fails on high-severity known vulnerabilities.

backlog.title: CI job: validate Docker image build
backlog.description: CI job runs docker build on every PR (no push) to catch Dockerfile breakage before merge, independent of the GHCR publish step.

backlog.title: Add pull request template
backlog.description: .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md prompts for change summary, testing performed, and migration/rollback notes so every PR carries consistent context.

backlog.title: Enable branch protection requiring CI checks
backlog.description: main branch protection configured to require lint/typecheck, test, migration round-trip, import-linter, pip-audit, and docker-build checks to pass plus at least one review before merge.

backlog.title: CI: build + push image to GHCR on main
backlog.description: On merge to main, a workflow builds the production image and pushes it to GHCR tagged with the commit SHA (and latest), reusing the Dockerfile validated in CI.

backlog.title: Provision VPS: Docker, firewall, DNS record
backlog.description: Target VPS has Docker + Compose installed, firewall allows only 22/80/443, and the project domain's A record points at the VPS IP.

backlog.title: Add GitHub Actions deploy secrets (SSH)
backlog.description: Deploy SSH private key, host, and user stored as GitHub Actions repo secrets; a minimal test workflow confirms SSH connectivity from Actions to the VPS.

backlog.title: Configure production Caddy for real domain TLS
backlog.description: Production Caddyfile on the VPS reverse-proxies the real domain to the api container and lets Caddy provision/renew TLS automatically via ACME; verified with a manual docker compose up on the VPS.

backlog.title: Add tag-triggered deploy workflow (SSH + migrate)
backlog.description: Pushing a version tag triggers a workflow that SSHes into the VPS, pulls the SHA-tagged image from GHCR, runs alembic upgrade head against production, then docker compose up -d.

backlog.title: Add health-gated deploy swap with auto-rollback
backlog.description: Deploy workflow polls /readyz after compose up; on success the swap is complete, on failure it aborts and leaves the previous container running untouched, with the workflow reporting failure clearly.

backlog.title: Ship first production deploy (day-5 milestone)
backlog.description: Tag a release, run the full pipeline end to end, and confirm https://<domain>/readyz returns 200 over real TLS with no manual intervention — the "skeleton in production" milestone.

backlog.title: Adopt conventional commits via pre-commit hook
backlog.description: A commit-msg hook (e.g. commitlint or a pre-commit hook) enforces conventional commit format locally, matching the convention documented in README/CONTRIBUTING.

backlog.title: Write first ADR: Phase 0 stack + deploy decisions
backlog.description: docs/adr/0001-phase-0-skeleton.md records the key choices (uv, Alembic-only migrations, Caddy for TLS, health-gated deploy) and the alternatives rejected, in the project's ADR format.

backlog.title: Finalize README: setup, env vars, image size
backlog.description: README covers local setup (Makefile targets), full env var reference (linking .env.example), final Docker image size, and a one-paragraph architecture overview of the running stack.
